Chapter 6157: Any Last Words?

Chapter 6157: Any Last Words?

Hidden Ancestor was rumored to be the progenitor of Enigma and the reason for its repeated resurrection.

“Things make sense now, so he’s Hidden Ancestor.” One emperor said.

Their confusion and questions were resolved with this revelation. Li Qiye’s appearance and feats surprised them all - a mortal capable of inexplicable and heaven-defying tasks.

It broke logic and reason but now, a reasonable explanation presented itself.

“That’s irrelevant.” Li Qiye said: “Just know that I am here to help your dynasty in its suicidal quest. Immortal Suppression shall be no more after today.”

This was not the first time he had said something like this in the most indifferent tone. People couldn’t help but gasp since he still delivered these domineering words while facing the dynasty.

It had existed at the start of Sin, enjoying full authority. In previous eras, powerful cultivators and sects tried to replace it to no avail. It remained the true lord of Sin.

“Can he do it?” This became the question on everyone’s mind.

“Rumble!” Immortal Suppression Dynasty’s response was direct.

Pillars of power emanated from desolate gods and emperors. Divine rings stretched across the firmament, pushing up three thousand worlds and the various cycles.

The crowd naturally couldn’t withstand the mere pressure from their auras. This applied to living beings in Sin as well.

“This is the foundation of Immortal Suppression, nothing else comes close.” A desolate god took a deep breath.

The majestic scene of the dao deriving into wonderful visual phenomena left the crowd speechless.

“That’s all?” Li Qiye brushed his robe, clearly not impressed.

The immense activation of power engulfing Sin was nothing more than a breeze, merely making his sleeves flutter.

“Last call for last words.” Li Qiye entered the dynasty.

The ordinary statement pierced everyone’s heart like a sharp spear, nailing them to the ground in this fleeting moment. The emperors from Immortal Suppression felt the same way, thinking that they had been sentenced to death.

“Kill him!” A roar erupted from within.

Members of the dynasty couldn’t surrender or flee before Li Qiye. They had too much pride due to their history.

Ordinary disciples, experts, ancestors, and desolate gods have already assumed the proper positions. They poured their dao power and vitality into the dao momentum without any hesitation.

“Immortal Suppression!” The activation cry shook the whole of Sin.

“Rumble!” An endless stream of light erupted devastatingly, forming an ocean of brilliance above.

A gigantic fist could be seen within the ocean. It pulsed with an immortal light as laws looking like heavenly waterfalls poured downward.

The world trembled before this attack capable of obliterating everything.
